[[File:Rulebook-2.0-card-p04-1.png|thumb|right|320px|Cards cycle through the Reserve Deck, Force Pile and Used Pile.]]
A player's '''Life Force''' is all the cards in their Reserve Deck, Force Pile and Used Pile. Cards in hand, on the table or in the Lost Pile are outside those three piles. A player whose Life Force is completely depleted loses the game.<ref name="rb20">[[Media:Decipher Rulebook 2.0.pdf|Star Wars Customizable Card Game Rulebook, Version 2.0]], Decipher (November 1998), pp. 2–5, 8–9 and 12. [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0|Wiki transcription]].</ref>

== Reserve Deck ==

In the basic setup, after placing starting locations, each player shuffles the rest of their deck and places it face down as the Reserve Deck. To draw destiny, reveal the top card of the Reserve Deck.<ref name="rb20" />

== Force Pile ==

In the [[Phase#Activate phase|activate phase]], a player activates Force by moving cards face down from the top of the Reserve Deck to the Force Pile. The Force Pile holds the Force available to spend or draw into hand. Cards can remain in this pile across turns.<ref name="rb20" />

== Used Pile ==

To spend Force, a player moves cards one at a time, face down, from the Force Pile to the Used Pile. At the end of every turn, both players put their Used Piles beneath their Reserve Decks.<ref name="rb20" />

== Lost Pile ==

Lost and forfeited cards go face up to the Lost Pile. Some cards can retrieve them.<ref name="rb20" />

== Hand ==

Each player normally draws eight cards from the Reserve Deck for their starting hand. During the [[Phase#Draw phase|draw phase]], they may draw from the Force Pile. There is no hand-size limit.<ref name="rb20" />

== Losing Force ==

When a player must lose Force, they choose cards from their hand or from the top of their Reserve Deck, Force Pile or Used Pile. They put the cards face up on the Lost Pile one at a time. [[Force drain|Force drains]] and [[Battle|battle]] damage can cause Force loss.<ref name="rb20" />
